en.title: Deeper analysis, clearer evidence
en.text: Expanded business, cash-flow, risk and follow-up analysis for 12 companies in both languages. Each period now opens the latest analysis. Fiscal-calendar labels, the Auto option and evidence styling are clearer.

zh.title: 分析与原文依据更新
zh.text: 已补充 12 家公司的双语业务、现金流、风险及跟踪分析。每个财季默认展示最新分析，并改进财季说明、自动主题选项和原文依据样式。

en.title: More research, in your language
en.text: Coverage now includes 15 companies. English and Chinese editions, light and dark themes, release notes and anonymous reading statistics are now available.

zh.title: 研究体验更新
zh.text: 真实财报覆盖已扩展至 15 家公司，同时加入中英文分析、白天与黑夜主题、更新公告及匿名阅读统计。
